Step.SQLStatement: UPDATE AD_Field f SET IsAllowCopy = 'N' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AD_Table t INNER JOIN AD_Column c ON (c.AD_Table_ID = t.AD_Table_ID) WHERE c.AD_Column_ID = f.AD_Column_ID AND t.TableName = 'C_BPartner' AND c.ColumnName IN ('SalesVolume', 'SO_CreditLimit', 'SO_CreditUsed', 'AcqusitionCost', 'PotentialLifeTimeValue', 'ActualLifeTimeValue', 'ShareOfCustomer', 'AD_OrgBP_ID', 'TotalOpenBalance')) ;
Step.RollbackStatement: UPDATE AD_Field f SET IsAllowCopy = 'Y' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM AD_Table t INNER JOIN AD_Column c ON (c.AD_Table_ID = t.AD_Table_ID) WHERE c.AD_Column_ID = f.AD_Column_ID AND t.TableName = 'C_BPartner' AND c.ColumnName IN ('SalesVolume', 'SO_CreditLimit', 'SO_CreditUsed', 'AcqusitionCost', 'PotentialLifeTimeValue', 'ActualLifeTimeValue', 'ShareOfCustomer', 'AD_OrgBP_ID', 'TotalOpenBalance')) ;;
